result.topic_en: Closing portion of Riemann's Latin letter of application to the Göttingen philosophical faculty for the doctorate, presenting his dissertation on the foundations of a general theory of functions of a complex variable, dated October 1851 and signed.
result.transcription:
sit exigua, philosophiae doctorem me creetis. Specimini dignitatis scripsi dissertationem,
quae in jaciendis fundamentis theoriae generalis functionum complexae quantitatis varia-
bilis {+versatur+} [-collocata est-]. Quam Vobis jam subjicere judicibus audeo. Scripsi {+Gottingae+} [-die XXIX-] mensis
Octobris anni MDCCCLI.

G. F. B. Riemann, stud. math.

items.quote: Quam Vobis jam subjicere judicibus audeo.
items.english: Which I now dare to submit to you as judges.
